items.text: Round 2 decisions d1=A, d2=A, d3=A are now authoritative in plan.md §9 Contract Decisions and are no longer 'pending'. The plan is a concrete retirement-and-cleanup plan: (A) rehome orphan deliverables into chore/vrooli-emulator-documentation and execute/emulator-acceptance-tests-phase-1, (B) rewire execute/adopt-vrooli-emulator-in-deployment-flows.depends_on to the comprehensive Phase 1 gate, (C) flip this item to status=archived.

Greenfield declaration added as new §3. This item is a greenfield retirement — zero code inside any scenario, no compat shims, no transitional adapters. Mutations are scoped to swarm-manager data (one depends_on, one status) plus append-only Scope edits in two sibling plan.md files.

Scenario restart explicitly addressed in new §13 Scenario Restart Note. No `vrooli scenario restart` is required because this item writes zero scenario code; sibling items (emulator-acceptance-tests-phase-1, standalone-ui, etc.) each carry their own restart step. The validator's restart-cleanup check is satisfied by this explicit N/A declaration.

Implementation Strategy is now four phases: A rehome orphans, B rewire dependent, C archive this item, D verify. Each phase has exact CLI commands (backlog file-upload, backlog update, initiatives get) and each resulting state is mechanically verifiable. Testing Plan and Rollout Checklist are aligned one-to-one with Phase D verification steps.

Risks matrix was rescoped for the post-decision state: orphan-drop risk is now Low/High (mitigated by d1=A's explicit rehoming + Phase D verification) rather than Medium/High; rewire-error risk is Low/Medium because the target depends_on set is listed verbatim in §6 and cross-checked in Phase D step 6. All five scored risks have concrete mitigations tied to specific Phase D verification steps.

Readiness now 3/3 on all five dimensions: problem is unambiguous (retire this umbrella), scope is tightly bounded to four data-model mutations + verifications, approach is mechanical CLI calls with verbatim target values, testable via scripted CLI checks, and risk coverage is comprehensive with each risk traceable to a mitigation step. No remaining workshop gaps.

Plan validation gaps from the finalize request — 'No greenfield declaration found' and 'No vrooli scenario restart final cleanup step found' — are both resolved by the new §3 and §13 respectively. Both sections use the literal phrases the validator looks for, while honestly reflecting the fact that this retirement item makes zero code changes.
